Company A initiated a 2018 acquisition effort and made two indications before withdrawing; Liontree outreach produced no other bids. A separate 2019 effort involved Company C and ended without agreement, while merger-of-equals talks with Company B, the target’s attempted acquisition of Company D, and partial-business proposals remained outside the whole-company contest. Renewed outreach in July 2020 produced whole-company offers from Company E and CLP, while Company G sought only software and services. Company E obtained exclusivity but later shifted to a 35% tender offer, and the target reopened outreach after exclusivity and again in December. CLP returned, increased its offer from $1.88 to $2.00, and was selected for definitive negotiation as Company H failed to submit an offer. CLP ultimately increased the cash price to $2.20, and the parties signed on February 10, 2021 and announced the transaction the next day.
